status: Proposal (UI designer, 2026-10-09 13:04, America/Mexico_City): the L2.4 spec, one milestone ahead of the build (lvgl-switch.md §3, §4 L2.4). Every drawn region names its word (`component`) or composition (`build`) from the closed vocabulary; the states shape and grow; the roll among three pictures as a ▲▼ stepper; changed tags, clash marks and the total on the bottom line; focus as data; colour roles from the palette; the roll and grow events. The structure (states and navigation) goes to the owner's structure check; the details are the UI designer's, with the open questions in station-layouts.md, Create
note: The one home of the Create numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Create) and its wireframes 03-create.svg to 03d-create-nav.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels. Create shapes a founder from one read pod: the founder is the spotlight, the roll of the focused trait sits over it, the pod at the left and the incubation chamber, its leaves and the stamp at the right balance it, the total is on the bottom line.

rules.closedList: lvgl-switch.md §2.2 layout/: railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups

stateRule: shape: the screen at rest and while the player rolls; its conditions (changed, clash, busy, noBay, short) change marks and the bottom line, never regions. grow: from ✓ Grow it until the screen changes to the Incubator (events.grow), input held. A region with `inStates` exists only in those states; the others exist in both

bench.note: the research bench's ground, as on Pods (pods.json regions.*.bench)

rail.open: the focused trait's chapter (the open tab, frame.json rail.states.open)

tabs.unread: a chapter not read: it stays a surprise

pips.clash: the 6×6 ✕ pip-clash-6x6 in place of the pip
pips.focused: the focused trait's pip lifted 2 px: y 69 to 75 (was 71 to 77); no ring

single.when: a doing, a trait the pod carries one look of, or a trait that cannot be shaped

roll.chosen: the picture of the trait's choice (0, 1 or 2); single: the one picture

clashEdge.on: the chosen picture of a clashing trait

tag.w: the word's width + 16, rounded up to the 8 px grid ("changed": 66 + 16 → 88)
tag.when: the focused trait is changed and does not clash

clashMark.note: the ✕ is the text word's inline 16 px icon (lvgl-switch.md §2.2, primitives: text), the line's first glyph; no tag then

breedMark.when: the focused trait is a doing
breedMark.note: the two joined rings, after the trait's name as on the chapter page (owner, 2026-10-08 21:55: marks as small glyphs after the name)

traitLine.place: the group (tag or mark, its gap, the line) centred on x 512; built as nameTag is on Home: the composition sizes its own tag from the word

chamber.note: the specimen chamber's glass back; no words

founder.asset: the founder's placeholder at 304×312 (the stylised rig pass)
founder.frost: the parts of every unread chapter's traits frosted, never a guess

chamberFront.note: the glass's edge and highlight and the floor, drawn over the founder

pod.classes: pods.json classes.pod: large 144×176, medium 120×152, small 104×128 by the species' size class, bottom-centred on (axis, feet)

cradleFront.note: the dish's near lip over the pod's foot, as on Pods

origin.text: the origin sentence of Pods' overview (pods.json regions.overview.origin), its words the copywriter's

dome.note: the incubation chamber, empty: the dome's back and its base; Create's own small dome, not the Incubator's

bud.when: busy: a bud is growing, its glow in the dome

domeFront.note: the dome's glass edge and highlight, drawn over the bud and the travelling pod

leaves.count: one a minute the bud will take: the rules' budMinutes for this choice, changing as the rolls change

stamp.offGrid: x 804 centres the 120 label on the right column's axis (864), 4 px off the grid, as Home's juvenile and the medium pod are
stamp.live: the stamp of the read and changed chapters, redrawn as the rolls change

travel.path: a straight line, whole pixels, eased in and out
travel.layer: drawn after the dome's back and before the chamber, the roll and the dome's front: it passes behind the specimen chamber and ends inside the dome

roll.do: the founder's picture changes to the new choice in its box by the 16-level Bayer dither clipped to the founder's rectangle (open question 3, architect; until answered, a cut); the ring, the notches, the trait line, the pip, the stamp's cells and the price change on the frame of the key

steps.do: the stamp prints: its cells drawn row by row from the top, N + 2 rows over 300 ms, whole rows
the code appears on the rule (a cut)
the pod travels from its box to the dome (regions.travel); the cradle stays, empty
the screen transition (16-level Bayer dither) to the Incubator, growing (incubator.json)

roll.note: a stepper group: the four keys send intent step:<key> and the ring stays (lvgl-switch.md §2.1); the spec form `stepper` is open question 2 (architect)
the ring never leaves the roll, so it does not lift

keys.left: step:left, the previous read trait in ring order, skipping unread chapters; the first stops
keys.right: step:right, the next read trait; the last stops
keys.up: step:up, the previous look of the focused trait, wrapping among the three; a single: nothing
keys.down: step:down, the next look, wrapping; a single: nothing
keys.confirm: Grow it, exactly as the bottom line says; no ✓ cap when blocked (clash, busy, no bay): nothing happens; a dimmed cap when short: a message plate names what is short (frame.json navigation.keys.confirm)
keys.back: the pod's overview with the ring on the pod, nothing spent, the choices dropped (frame.json navigation.screens.create)
keys.room: drops the unpaid choices; coming back starts fresh (frame.json navigation.leaving.create)

focus.held: while events.grow holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent

bottomLine.action: ✓ Grow it, then the price (state.growCost): Energy, Essence (none for the first founder), Data a change, ticking as the rolls change
bottomLine.context: what stays a surprise (strings.surprise); every chapter read: the founder (strings.founder)
bottomLine.notice: a block, the most pressing first: clash (strings.clash), busy (strings.busy), no bay (strings.noBay), with the amber lamp; otherwise the frame's notice

conditions.ok: the ✓ cap and the verb in orange, the price in bone
conditions.short: the frame's dimmed ✓: cap and verb mist, the short material's figure amber; ✓ shows a message plate naming what is short, nothing spent
conditions.blocked: clash, busy or no bay: no ✓ cap; the verb and the price in mist, so the total still reads; the notice says why; ✓ does nothing

rail.note: the tabs' fills, words and pips are frame.json rail.states

strings.title: Create

surprise.budget: 208 px at 16 px, the context zone
